rationale: Two major test defects: the 'Not shared' assertion in WorkflowCard.test is trivially true (WorkflowShared never renders 'Not shared' when shared=true, so the assertion can never fail regardless of whether the fix is present), and there is no positive regression test confirming sharing status is still rendered on non-template workflow cards (all WorkflowCard tests use isTemplate=true, leaving AC-5 unverified by the suite). Production code is correct; all acceptance criteria are met in logic. Only test quality blocks.

business_review.text: "Shared with Project" is not displayed on Assistants template cards.
business_review.notes: AssistantCard passes null for status when isTemplate=true; Card's {status && (...)} guard suppresses the row cleanly.

business_review.text: "Shared with Project" is not displayed on Workflows template cards.
business_review.notes: WorkflowCard wraps the sharing div with {!isTemplate && (...)}; new test confirms text absent.

business_review.text: No empty spacing or alignment gap is left after removal.
business_review.notes: AssistantCard uses null-suppression via Card's existing guard; WorkflowCard outer flex container retains other children (Create Workflow button).

business_review.text: Existing template card actions (Create Workflow, more options, favorite) continue to work.
business_review.notes: Changes are isolated to sharing-status paths only; action handlers, buttons, and topRight slot are untouched.

business_review.text: Non-template Assistants and Workflows cards continue to display sharing status unchanged.
business_review.notes: Production code is correct (changes gated on isTemplate=true), but no test in the suite renders a WorkflowCard without isTemplate to assert the sharing label is still present — AC-5 is unverified by the test suite.

standards_review.notes: Both commits match EPMCDME-\d+: Capital sentence — 'EPMCDME-13545: Suppress sharing label on assistant template cards' and 'EPMCDME-13545: Suppress sharing block on workflow template cards'.
No secrets, user input, injection vectors, or auth concerns in the diff.

findings.problem: In WorkflowCard.test.tsx, the assertion `expect(screen.queryByText('Not shared')).not.toBeInTheDocument()` is trivially true when the fixture is `makeWorkflow({ shared: true })` — WorkflowShared only renders 'Not shared' when the workflow is NOT shared, so this assertion passes even on a completely broken build. It provides zero regression protection for the 'Not shared' branch.
findings.impact: A future regression that accidentally renders 'Not shared' on a template card when `shared: false` would not be caught. The test gives false confidence that both sharing-text variants are suppressed.
findings.recommendation: Change the fixture to `makeWorkflow({ shared: false })` (which would trigger the 'Not shared' branch) so both assertions are non-trivial, or add a second test case with `shared: false`.

findings.problem: No WorkflowCard test renders the card without `isTemplate` to verify that sharing status is still displayed for non-template cards. All three WorkflowCard tests (heading, new template-suppression, existing heading test) pass `isTemplate`. If the guard were accidentally inverted to `isTemplate &&` instead of `!isTemplate &&`, no test would catch the regression.
findings.impact: Regression risk: the guarding condition could be silently inverted in a refactor and no test would fail. AC-5 ('Non-template cards continue to display sharing status unchanged') is unverified by the suite.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: `render(<WorkflowCard workflow={makeWorkflow({ shared: true })} />)` (no isTemplate) and assert `screen.getByText('Shared with Project')` is present.
